skill.name: chapter-outline-generator
skill.description: Creates structured book chapter outlines with narrative beats, key events, conflicts, character development, themes, subplots, and chapter transitions.
skill.summary: Turn a story premise into a detailed, consistent chapter-by-chapter plan.
skill.author: Amraha-Anwar

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only SKILL.md file. Manual review found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, executable behavior, or other semantic security concerns.

content.value_statement: Turning a story premise into a coherent chapter plan requires careful control of pacing, character growth, and continuity. This skill creates structured chapter outlines with clear narrative progression and transitions.
actual_capabilities: Requests a book title, genre, plot summary, and chapter count when those details are missing.
Organizes the story around setup, inciting incident, rising action, midpoint, climax, falling action, and resolution.
Creates a title, key events, conflicts, character moments, emotional tone, and themes for each chapter.
Adds relevant subplots, foreshadowing, or lore to chapter plans.
Provides a transition or cliffhanger between chapters.
Formats the completed outline as a clear Markdown list and checks narrative continuity.
limitations: The skill creates outlines, not complete manuscript chapters or polished prose.
Output quality depends on the detail and consistency of the supplied story information.
Standard narrative beats may need adaptation for nonlinear, experimental, or nonfiction projects.
The skill cannot verify facts or story canon that the user does not provide.

use_cases.title: Plan a First Novel
use_cases.description: Expand a premise into manageable chapters with clear conflicts, character development, and pacing.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Book Series
use_cases.description: Map subplots, lore, foreshadowing, and character arcs across a new installment while preserving supplied canon.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Story Structure
use_cases.description: Rebuild an uneven draft as a chapter outline to identify missing beats, weak transitions, and continuity problems.

prompt_templates.title: Outline a Simple Story
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [chapter count]-chapter outline for a [genre] book titled [title]. The main plot is: [plot summary].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this starting template when the core premise and desired length are already known.

prompt_templates.title: Control the Narrative Arc
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline [title] in [chapter count] chapters using this plot: [summary]. Place [inciting event], [midpoint], and [climax] at effective points.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this template to control major story beats and pacing.

prompt_templates.title: Develop Characters and Subplots
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a chapter outline for [title]. Track [character arc] and [subplot] alongside the main plot. Include conflicts, emotional tone, foreshadowing, and transitions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this template when character progression and layered story threads need equal attention.

prompt_templates.title: Rebuild an Existing Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this outline: [existing outline]. Reorganize it into [chapter count] chapters while preserving [required events]. Resolve contradictions and strengthen pacing, foreshadowing, arcs, and cliffhangers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this advanced template to revise a developed story plan under explicit continuity constraints.

output_examples.input: Outline a twelve-chapter coastal mystery about a baker investigating a missing recipe.
output: A festival delivery reveals the town founder's recipe is missing, threatening the bakery and exposing an old rivalry.
Mara notices salt crystals inside the locked box, leading her toward the abandoned cannery.

output_examples.input: Plan the midpoint chapter of a fantasy novel where an apprentice discovers her mentor serves the enemy.
output: The apprentice intercepts a coded message and confronts her mentor during the capital's evacuation.
Her trust becomes resolve, and the mentor's escape reveals that the invasion is a diversion.

output_examples.input: Revise a final chapter so the main conflict resolves while a series subplot remains open.
output: Chapter 24: Dawn at the Northern Gate
The protagonist exposes the council's conspiracy and restores the displaced families, completing the central justice arc.
A sealed map from the missing cartographer points beyond the border, leaving the larger mystery active.

best_practices: Provide the genre, chapter count, central conflict, ending, and major character goals before generation.
Identify required story beats and continuity rules that the outline must preserve.
Review pacing, causality, and character motivation before expanding the outline into prose.
anti_patterns: Do not provide only a title and expect a distinctive, internally consistent plot.
Do not combine conflicting character histories or outcomes without explaining which version controls.
Do not treat the first outline as final without checking chapter balance and narrative logic.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the book title, genre, main plot summary, and desired chapter count. Character goals, ending details, and required scenes improve precision.

faq.question: Can it outline any fiction genre?
faq.answer: Yes. It can apply the requested structure to many fiction genres when given suitable conventions, tone, and story constraints.

faq.question: Does it write complete chapters?
faq.answer: No. It produces detailed chapter plans with events, conflicts, character moments, themes, and transitions.

faq.question: Can it revise an existing outline?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply the current outline, required events, continuity rules, and specific pacing or character problems to address.

faq.question: How does it handle subplots?
faq.answer: It can place supplied subplots, foreshadowing, and lore across chapters while connecting them to the main plot.

faq.question: Can it prevent every continuity error?
faq.answer: No. It checks the provided plan for logical flow, but it cannot detect missing facts or unseen manuscript details.
